inlines.v: DECI'DED, participle passive Determined; ended; concluded. DECI'DED, adjective That implies decision; clear; unequivocal; that puts an end to doubt. I find much cause to reproach myself, that I have lived so long, and have given no decided and public proofs of my being a christian. P. Henry, Wirt's Sketches.
